title: The mud kitchen that breathes
text: In Kangra, concrete rooms trap summer heat and become damp iceboxes in winter, while a traditional mud-and-slate kitchen stays cool in summer and warm in winter. The writer ends: 'Concrete doesn't bend.'
use: For 'Forests precede civilizations and deserts follow them' (2024) and 'Nature is the symbol of the spirit' (2026).

title: A label claimed three times
text: Egypt, Brazil and Turkey all promised an 'implementation COP'; yet only about 5% of 203 voluntary climate initiatives since 2015 met their goals (CEEW).
use: For 'The cost of being wrong is less than the cost of doing nothing' (2024) and 'The time to repair the roof is when the sun is shining' (2022).

title: Clean power, fragile grid
text: Sri Lanka's grid collapsed in October 2026 when rooftop solar inverters disconnected together: clean technology without the systems to support it can turn a small fault into a national blackout.
use: For 'Alternative technologies for a climate change resilient India' (2018).

title: A war far away, a queue at the gas agency
text: When shipping through the Strait of Hormuz stalled in March, Indian families queued for cooking gas and induction cooktops sold out within weeks: a conflict thousands of kilometres away had reached the kitchen.
use: For 'Alternative technologies for a climate change resilient India' (2018) and 'Technology as the silent factor in international relations' (2020).

title: Hard choices on subsidies
text: Facing a 'super strong' El Niño, the editorial says India must treat climate change and geopolitical tension as default realities and reorder its inefficient subsidy regime, a challenge it calls political more than economic.
use: For 'Shelving hard decisions is the least ethical course' (2026) and 'We may brave human laws but cannot resist natural laws' (2017).
